abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Autoimmune pancreatitis (AIP) is a chronic fibroinflammatory pancreatic disease classified as Type 1, Type 2, and not otherwise specified (AIP-NOS). Although chronic pancreatitis is associated with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), malignancy risk in AIP remains uncertain. We aimed to assess incidence of PDAC and extrapancreatic cancers in AIP and compare with population estimates.
METHODS: We conducted a comparative cohort study of adults diagnosed with AIP by International Consensus Diagnostic Criteria between 2000-2023, excluding patients with prior or concurrent PDAC. Cancer outcomes were analyzed using Cox proportional hazards models and incidence rates per 1000 person-years, adjusting for age, sex, and relapse. Expected cancer incidence was derived from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database and compared using Poisson regression to estimate risk ratios (RRs).
RESULTS: Among 282 patients with AIP (199 Type 1, 64 Type 2, 19 AIP-NOS), patients with Type 1 AIP were older, predominantly male, had higher smoking rates, and more frequent relapses (all p<0.05). Cancer incidence was highest in Type 1 AIP (23.7 per 1000 person-years; 95% CI 16.4-33.1; p=0.045). Relapses did not increase cancer risk. Compared to age- and sex-adjusted SEER estimates, overall cancer risk in AIP was not increased (RR 1.30; 95% CI 0.95-1.78; p=0.10). However, PDAC risk was significantly higher (RR 3.67; 95% CI 1.18-11.38; p=0.024), primarily in Type 1 AIP (RR 4.24; 95% CI 1.37-13.13; p=0.012).
DISCUSSION: Type 1 AIP was associated with the highest observed incidence of pancreatic and extrapancreatic malignancies in this cohort. Large-scale studies are needed to identify factors linked to PDAC risk in AIP.
key_points_ko: 총 282명의 자가면역성 췌장염(199명 제1형, 64명 제2형, 19명 AIP-NOS) 환자가 분석에 포함되었습니다.
암 발생률은 제1형 자가면역성 췌장염에서 1000인년당 23.7명으로 가장 높았습니다.
전체 암 위험은 증가하지 않았으나(위험비 1.30), 췌관선암(PDAC) 위험은 유의하게 높았습니다(위험비 3.67).
췌관선암 위험의 표출은 주로 제1형 자가면역성 췌장염 환자에서 나타났습니다(위험비 4.24).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 자가면역성 췌장염(AIP) 환자들을 대상으로 췌관선암(PDAC) 및 췌장 외 암의 발생 위험을 평가하기 위해 수행되었습니다. 2000년부터 2023년 사이 자가면역성 췌장염으로 진단된 성인 282명을 대상으로 SEER 데이터베이스와 비교 분석을 진행했습니다. 분석 결과, 전체 암 위험은 통계적으로 유의하게 증가하지 않았으나, 췌관선암(PDAC) 위험은 제1형 자가면역성 췌장염을 중심으로 유의하게 증가했습니다. 제1형 자가면역성 췌장염 환자들은 더 고령이고 남성 비율이 높았으며 흡연율과 재발 빈도가 높았습니다.
title: Risk of Cancer in Autoimmune Pancreatitis: A Comparative Cohort Analysis Using SEER Population-Based Data
